steps.title: Update Database Helper for Photo Schema
steps.description: Increment database version to 3 and add image_path column migration for medicines, customers, suppliers, sales, and purchases tables.

steps.title: Implement PhotoHelper Utility
steps.description: Add native image capture, photo picker, JPEG compression, orientation handling, thumbnail decoding, and full-screen preview dialog helper.

steps.title: Update Manifest Permissions and Camera Features
steps.description: Declare CAMERA permission and hardware feature with optional flag in AndroidManifest.xml.

steps.title: Add Localization Strings for Photo Options
steps.description: Add photo options (Take Photo, Choose Gallery, Replace, Remove) to English and Hindi resource bundles.

steps.title: Add Optional Photo Support to Customer Directory
steps.description: Update customer creation, edit forms, directory list, and Khata header with photo thumbnails and full-screen preview.

steps.title: Add Optional Photo Support to Medicine Inventory
steps.description: Integrate product photo selection into Add/Edit Medicine form and inventory list thumbnail rendering.

steps.title: Add Optional Photo Support to Supplier Directory
steps.description: Update supplier list layout and activity to display optional supplier profile thumbnails.

steps.title: Add Optional Attachment Photos to Sales Billing
steps.description: Enable optional receipt or prescription photo attachments in Sales screen and Sales history list.

steps.title: Add Optional Attachment Photos to Purchase Entry
steps.description: Enable optional bill/invoice attachment photo capture in New Purchase screen.

steps.title: Integrate Photos Folder into ZIP Backup and Restore
steps.description: Update BackupRestoreActivity to pack all photo subdirectories into ZIP backup and safely restore photos and database.

steps.title: Building Mumbai Medical
steps.description: Recompile Mumbai Medical application with full optional photo management and ZIP archive integration.
